promptText: When an owner wants a collection or soft-brand option for a hotel conversion in Mexico, which brands are commonly considered?
rawResponse:
Here’s a refined overview of the **soft‑brand or “collection” options** that hotel owners commonly consider when converting an existing property in **Mexico**:

---

###  Global Soft‑Brand Options Suitable for Mexico

Major hotel groups offer soft-brand programs designed specifically for conversion-friendly opportunities. These include:

- **Marriott International**  
  - *Autograph Collection* – A lifestyle-driven soft brand for upscale‑to‑upper‑upscale properties ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).  
  - *Tribute Portfolio* and *Design Hotels* also serve similar segments and are aimed at independent-minded properties ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).

- **Hilton Worldwide**  
  - *Curio Collection* – Targets luxury/tourist‑oriented conversions, giving retained unique identity with operational backing ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Curio_%28brand%29?utm_source=openai)).  
  - *Tapestry Collection* – A softer, more flexible option for mid‑scale to upscale independent hotels ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).

- **IHG (InterContinental Hotels Group)**  
  - *Vignette Collection* – Positioned for upscale to upper‑upscale conversions, offering flexibility while connecting to IHG’s channels ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).

- **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts**  
  - *Trademark Collection* – Upper‑midscale soft brand designed for independent properties ([hoteldevelopmentguide.com](https://hoteldevelopmentguide.com/hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)).  
  - *Registry Collection Hotels* – A higher‑end, upper‑upscale soft collection emphasizing individuality ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/convert-your-existing-hotel?utm_source=openai)).

- **Choice Hotels International**  
  - *Ascend Collection* – One of the earliest soft‑brand platforms, focused on boutique and historic properties ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ascend_Collection?utm_source=openai)).

- **Hyatt Hotels Corporation**  
  - *Unbound Collection* – A storytelling‑focused, upmarket soft brand tailored for independent, experience‑driven hotels ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyatt?utm_source=openai)).  
  - Other lifestyle names like *Joie de Vivre*, *Caption by Hyatt* also function as soft or lifestyle‑oriented brands ([insights.ehotelier.com](https://insights.ehotelier.com/insights/2025/02/26/case-study-in-soft-brand-success-with-faro-blanco-resort-autograph-collection/?utm_source=openai)).

- **Sonesta**  
  - *MOD (Mod Soft Brand Collection)* – A modern, creative soft brand positioned for conversion or new builds, competing with Tribute, Ascend, Tapestry, etc. ([franchise.sonesta.com](https://franchise.sonesta.com/brands/mod/?utm_source=openai)).

- **Accor**  
  - Though less prominent in Mexico’s conversion landscape, Accor offers options like *MGallery Collection*, *Handwritten*, and – in broader Latin America – soft‑brand capabilities ([hotelave.com](https://www.hotelave.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/hotelave-brandscape.pdf?utm_source=openai)).

---

###  Soft‑Brand Activity in Mexico: Evidence & Trends

- **Marriott’s Autograph Collection** has been actively licensing independent and all-inclusive resorts, particularly in **Cancún** ([costar.com](https://www.costar.com/article/1218949022/mexico-weathers-another-tourism-storm-faces-headwinds-in-2021?utm_source=openai)).

- **Hilton’s Curio Collection** has seen recent soft‑brand conversions in key Mexican destinations including **Monterrey** and **Tulum** ([costar.com](https://www.costar.com/article/1218949022/mexico-weathers-another-tourism-storm-faces-headwinds-in-2021?utm_source=openai)).

- **Posadas**, a Mexican operator, has developed its own soft‑brand, *Curamoria Collection*, with properties in **Querétaro**, **San Miguel de Allende**, and **Tulum** ([costar.com](https://www.costar.com/article/1218949022/mexico-weathers-another-tourism-storm-faces-headwinds-in-2021?utm_source=openai)).

---

###  Summary: Most Common Soft‑Brands for Conversions in Mexico

When converting a hotel in Mexico—particularly in popular destinations like Cancún, Playa del Carmen, Tulum, or Mexico City—owners commonly evaluate:

- **Marriott**: *Autograph Collection*, *Tribute Portfolio*  
- **Hilton**: *Curio Collection*, *Tapestry Collection*  
- **IHG**: *Vignette Collection*  
- **Wyndham**: *Trademark Collection*, *Registry Collection*  
- **Choice**: *Ascend Collection*  
- **Hyatt**: *Unbound Collection* (and select lifestyle collections)  
- **Sonesta**: *MOD Collection*  
- **Accor**: *MGallery*, *Handwritten*, etc. (less dominant in Mexico but recognized globally)  
- **Domestically**: *Curamoria Collection* by Grupo Posadas

---

###  Why These Brands Are Attractive for Owners

Soft brands offer a compelling blend of **operational flexibility** and **branding advantages**:

- They enable owners to preserve a property's **unique architecture, character, or history** while gaining access to global **distribution systems**, **loyalty programs**, and **operational support** ([hospitalitas.com.mx](https://hospitalitas.com.mx/2022/07/28/entendiendo-el-modelo-de-negocio-de-las-soft-brands-hoteleras/?utm_source=openai)).

- These soft-brand conversions often lead to **higher ADRs**, improved revenue performance, and strong owner returns—all while maintaining a property's individual charm ([insights.ehotelier.com](https://insights.ehotelier.com/insights/2025/02/26/case-study-in-soft-brand-success-with-faro-blanco-resort-autograph-collection/?utm_source=openai)).
